rule: For mean‑reversion entries, require the price to touch a defined support (e.g., 20‑day SMA) and exhibit at least one bounce before taking the position.
Do not take long mean‑reversion trades on assets that are below both the 20‑day and 50‑day SMA unless a clear fundamental catalyst is present.
Do not enter short or fade trades on high-beta single stocks unless the price has confirmed a breakdown below its 20-day low.
For all mean-reversion long setups, require a confirmed higher-low candle close on the daily chart before entry rather than bidding directly into falling prices.
Switch hard intraday time‑stops to trailing stops once a trade is 0.2 R in profit; only use a time‑stop if the expected R is ≤0.2.
For earnings‑play entries, require an expected move ≥2 R and a stop‑loss ≤1 R; otherwise reject the trade.
Add a macro filter to short/fade forex trades: only enter when the USD is in a risk‑off environment (e.g., DXY down >0.2% over the prior 24 h).
